skillTree.localised_description: Men twice her size have fallen. That tale never grows old.
Many are the dark horrors of twisted flesh and nightmares made real that the Ruinous Powers have visited upon the world, but few are quite as vicious.
Some creatures charge home with such fury that the very ground shakes beneath their feet.
Creatures with tough hides or some kind of natural armour are tough nuts to crack - even a powerful attack may fall foul of their thick-skin.
Hand-to-hand combat is a lethal match of cut and thrust. However, it’s not all about offensive strikes; parries and other defensive moves can also win the day.
Don't go anywhere near its mouth - in fact, don't even get within snapping distance if you value your limbs.
From one bloodied, lifeless corpse to the next, this one is always looking for the next adversary to best.
Such is their power and ferocity, a wound-maker will ravage the foe, cutting and pulverising until there is only one exit - death.
It is never enough. The food, the drink, the slaughter. It is never, ever enough.
The iron will and indomitable presence of this leader ensures their followers remain steadfast when facing peril.
Blink and you die.
The war is endless. The cycle of charging, clashing, and bloody hand-to-hand fighting is without end. It will never stop.
"I am not here to inspire, I am here to kill - come let us draw blades together!"

items.colour_text: Forged beneath a storm-black sky and quenched in the blood of a fallen draugr, Draughjart — "Ghost-Heart" — is a blade both feared and whispered of in the North. Its edge is cold to the touch, even in the fiercest flame, and its surface bears faint etchings that shift like mist when drawn. Some say the blade thirsts for the unliving; others claim it was made to slay a wight-king who once haunted Ulfar's hall. Whatever the truth, it has become Dalla’s chosen weapon against the unnatural.

related_attributes.bullet_text: This unit frightens all enemy units, reducing their leadership when nearby. It is also immune to fear. Fear penalties do not stack.

items.colour_text: Wall-Heart is more than a shield, iit is a vow. Originally shaped from the broken hafts of three spears that failed to pierce it, the shield was reforged with the iron taken from the mouths of the dead. Dalla carries it not as a trophy, but as a bulwark of memory and duty. When she plants it into the ground, her warriors rally, and her enemies falter. The shield grows colder in the presence of fear, and heavier in the hand of any who would retreat. No force has broken it, though many have tried.

items.colour_text: A thread-thin chain of tarnished silver and storm-gold, Whisperskein was gifted by Ulfar to his daughter in silence. It hums when sorcery stirs and tightens against the throat when danger draws near. At times, Dalla swears she hears her father’s voice murmuring warnings only she can hear — soft as breath, sharp as prophecy. Whether the words are his or the echo of something darker, she does not care. She listens. And she survives.
